# Naming the income split of a cash sale as the settlement.
#
# The revenue is not money waiting to be identified — it is the sale. Moving it
# onto the receivable does not turn the entry into a payment of the invoice; it
# takes the sale out of the P&L and leaves an invoice reading paid by nothing.
#
# Every figure still agrees afterwards, which is what makes it worth refusing:
# bank +100.00 against a receivable of −100.00 balances exactly as bank against
# income did.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming the account and its type, with
# the entry untouched.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
invoice "INV-USD-001"
  customer_id: "C-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
    memo: "Invoice INV-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-03-16
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    txn_guid: "1122aabb3344ccdd5566eeff77880099"
    txn_split_guid: "aabb3344ccdd5566eeff77880099aabb"
